zvoove acquires Pixi, the AI agent to automate administrative work for staffing agencies
Minister: ingangsdatum toelatingsstelsel bureaus blijft 1 januari 2027
Zeitarbeit - Statistik der Bundesagentur für Arbeit
Bullhorn acquires TargetRecruit and expands Salesforce ecosystem to 150,000 users
Adecco Group partners with Bullhorn to drive AI-powered recruitment innovation

items.title: zvoove is a buy-and-build group with many overlapping staffing products
items.summary: zvoove lists acquisitions every year since 2019 (Rhb Landwehr 2019 through Pixi, KleanApp and profitask in 2026) and runs separate staffing brands per country: zvoove One/Cockpit (DE), HelloFlex, RecruitNow, Planbition, Pivoton, Plan4Flex (NL), ProSolution (AT), Nivel IV (ES), DirectSkills (FR), mywage (UK).
items.implication: Shared capabilities (rules engine, AI platform, metrics, integration) matter more than one monolithic product; enterprise customers need bridges before migrations.

items.title: Group scale figures differ between releases
items.summary: zvoove.com states 6,500+ customers; the May 2026 profitask release states 9,000+ customers. Both state 3 million+ workers and EUR 24 billion annual payroll volume; employees 1,000+ across 27-28 locations.
items.implication: Use ranges and cite the source when quoting customer counts; payroll volume is the more stable scale indicator.

items.title: AI agents move first contact with applicants to WhatsApp
items.summary: Cockpit X provides application, scheduling and check-in agents over WhatsApp; zvoove cites 250 hours saved per month by the application agent at a customer and states EU AI Act and GDPR compliance.
items.implication: Time to first contact becomes a recruiter KPI measured in minutes; oversight, logging and takeover must be first-class.

items.title: Worker self-service via an AI agent is the next admin lever
items.summary: Pixi, acquired August 2026, lets temporary workers complete onboarding via guided forms and get AI answers on personal details, contracts, assignments and hours over WhatsApp; launch in Switzerland first.
items.implication: Onboarding completion on the phone and agent-answered questions become measurable outcomes for workers and recruiters.

items.title: Software plus business process outsourcing
items.summary: profitask runs payroll for staffing firms on zvoove Payroll and provides outbound sales, training and employer-branding services; zvoove markets Managed Payroll (claim: 80% fewer correction invoices) and a Managed Sales Service.
items.implication: The platform must support service-centre operators working inside customer tenants with delegated, audited access and SLAs.

items.title: Compliance is built into the German ERP
items.summary: zvoove One lists AÜG, equal pay, GDPR and notification processes as integrated, implements the GVP collective agreement, maximum leasing duration and sector surcharges, and states law and tariff changes are applied automatically; zvoove claims 100,000+ users.
items.implication: Rule freshness (tariff updates before effective dates) is a retention driver for owners and payroll staff.

items.title: Dutch admission regime (Wtta) takes effect 1 January 2027
items.summary: Under the Wtta, lenders need admission (VOG, EUR 100,000 security deposit, proof of correct wages and taxes); users of temporary workers may only hire from admitted lenders, with enforcement from 1 January 2028. The minister confirmed the 1 January 2027 date in May 2026.
items.implication: Dutch brands (HelloFlex, Pivoton, Plan4Flex, Nocore Flex) need admission evidence, register checks and correct-wage proof in product.

items.title: VMS reveals contract errors and overbilling at client enterprises
items.summary: DirectSkills states that 80% of temp contracts contain errors and delays and that 4% of interim budgets stem from overbilling; it reports EUR 3.675bn interim invoicing, 1.735 million contracts and 145,000 users in 2024 and 99.9% penetration among French temp agencies.
items.implication: Client-side controls create pressure on agencies for exact invoices and fast contracts; the VMS is a network asset connecting clients and agency ERPs.

items.title: AI-assisted rostering sells on time saved
items.summary: Planbition claims 85% less time filling the schedule and 70% less communication overhead, 1,000+ installations in 17+ countries and 18+ standard APIs; Planbition X accepts plain-language planning instructions.
items.implication: Roster build time and AI proposal acceptance are the planner's adoption metrics.

items.title: UK agencies expect pay-on-demand and Salesforce-native tooling
items.summary: mywage positions an all-in-one platform on Salesforce with payroll (claim: up to 60% less processing time), scheduling (claim: 37% higher retention) and mypod pay-on-demand.
items.implication: Pay-on-demand is a worker retention lever that other countries may adopt; Salesforce-native competes with Bullhorn's ecosystem.

items.title: Global competitors are investing in AI through large staffing partnerships
items.summary: Bullhorn reports 10,000 customers and expanded its Salesforce ecosystem to 150,000 users; Adecco Group partnered with Bullhorn for AI-powered recruitment.
items.implication: Enterprise and multi-country staffing groups will compare zvoove's AI agents with Bullhorn's; European compliance depth is zvoove's differentiator.

items.title: The Dutch all-in-one agency segment is large and crowded
items.summary: HelloFlex reports 1,000+ customers; competitor Easyflex reports almost 1,500 agencies.
items.implication: In the Netherlands zvoove competes on compliance (Wtta) and bundled WFM (Planbition) rather than on basic payroll.
